title: 美股科技负反馈压制风险偏好，通信政策与A/H业绩仅保留条件机会
summary: 10月29日AKShare盘中快照显示A股953涨、4363跌、中位数-1.73%，恒生科技跌2.03%；隔夜纳指跌1.37%，互联网内容行业跌9.77%，Amazon和Intel盘后继续强化AI投入回报压力。通信网络与海南政策提供中期支撑，中际旭创、生益科技、东方证券列条件关注，百威亚太列回避；所有个股均以开盘量价为确认闸门。

关键词云图

美股通信服务AI资本开支A股弱广度恒科承压通信网络政策光模块业绩覆铜板券商并购啤酒需求海南自贸港油价高位减肥药
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东外交预期压低油价，但供应风险未解除
Brent结算114.88美元、跌0.38%，WTI结算102美元、跌0.76%；美伊接触预期与胡塞袭击、霍尔木兹风险并存。来源：Reuters。
政策
四部门发布海南自贸港贸易便利化措施
10月29日通知覆盖汽车测试进口、LNG期货交割、保险、离岸贸易和再制造等16项措施；受益需等实施与订单。来源：商务部。
产业
工信部部署新一代通信网络协同建设
会议提出基础、空间、国际和融合网络协同发展，并研究土地、电力、频率和金融支持；这是中期线索，不等于当日订单。来源：工信部。
市场
A/H科技弱于指数，AKShare宽度偏空
10月29日13:49 CST快照显示A股953涨、4363跌、97平，中位数-1.73%；创业板-2.87%、科创50-3.04%，恒科-2.03%。来源：AKShare快照。
美股
通信服务与软件重挫，互联网内容行业垫底
纳指跌1.37%、费半跌1.4%；Alphabet跌12.6%，FTNT与NOW均跌逾20%，MRVL跌13.2%。互联网内容与信息-9.77%，汽车经销+7.57%、安全防护+5.95%。来源：Reuters、排行快照。
盘后
Amazon与Intel强化AI投入回报压力
AWS收入增39%至460亿美元，但Amazon 12个月自由现金流为-424亿美元、资本开支高于预期，盘后最多跌7%；Intel的PC指引负反馈更重。来源：Reuters。
业绩
中际旭创业绩高增，公告前弱势构成反证
前三季营收277.69亿元、归母净利润85.87亿元，同比增173.74%；10月29日收582.05元、跌8.53%，财报收盘后披露，尚无公告后确认。来源：巨潮资讯。
业绩
新易盛增长仍强，但环比与现金流需消化
前三季营收109.40亿元、归母净利润38.43亿元；第三季利润环比约降19%，经营现金流同比下降。10月29日收228.40元、跌11.06%。来源：巨潮资讯。
业绩
生益科技盈利与现金流同步改善
第三季营收同比增78.76%、归母净利润34.40亿元并增238.40%；前三季经营现金流60.66亿元、增90.99%。10月29日收94.12元、跌8.17%。来源：公司三季报。
并购
东方证券合并上海证券获上交所审核通过
发行A股及现金购买上海证券100%股权仍需证监会及其他主管部门注册或批准；10月29日收8.25元、跌1.43%，协同需对照摊薄和整合成本。来源：巨潮资讯。
港股
吉利销量与利润增长，股价反馈仍偏弱
九个月收入2725.64亿元、归母净利润139.28亿元，核心利润增41%，但10月29日盘中约13.67港元、跌约4%，不能只凭增长包装为多头。来源：HKEX。
港股
百威亚太量价承压，列为回避
九个月收入46.2亿美元、降3.7%，销量降4.9%，正常化EBITDA降13.2%；第三季销量降10.1%，10月29日收5.66港元、跌2.58%。来源：HKEX。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘指数
本轮08:33 CST重新查询后，QQQ、SPY、DIA延迟代理分别报-1.41%、-0.35%、-0.36%，行情时间07:59 CST；来源未标识有效盘后成交，因此只作延迟代理，不冒充指数期货。
板块对照
板块对照
互联网内容与信息隔夜-9.77%，Amazon盘后最多跌7%、Intel盘后显著下跌，对港股互联网和高估值科技构成确认。CRMT、ADT、LUXE、GTN.A、CROX、MINE、DASH、EXK、TEX、MAX、LLY、NCLH、ESCA、HII、ARAY均未取得可核验盘后成交，不能默认延续；指数代理偏弱使正向榜单总体背离，尚不能判为反转。
A/H 映射
A/H 映射
开盘验证恒生科技、港股互联网及A股光模块/PCB相对强度；若中际旭创、生益科技守住前收附近且板块跌幅收敛，条件关注才有效。若HSTECH继续弱于恒指、科技龙头低开后30分钟无承接，则降权。

盘前结论

事实：A股与恒生科技上一交易日宽度偏弱，隔夜美股通信服务、软件和半导体继续承压，Amazon与Intel盘后又强化AI投入回报疑虑。

判断：大盘更可能低开后分化，防守和有本地业绩支撑的细分优先；光模块、PCB和券商并购仅作条件关注，必须以开盘相对强度验证。

结构机会来自通信网络政策、海南贸易便利化及个别高增长三季报。不确定性在于代表股多无可靠盘后成交、油价仍高，以及科技链已有明显负反馈。

重点个股关注

中际旭创
SZ.300308
条件关注

事实与状态：前三季营收277.69亿元、归母净利润85.87亿元并增173.74%；10月29日收582.05元、跌8.53%，报告后尚无价格确认。

确认条件：开盘不显著低于582.05元，前30分钟相对创业板和通信设备止跌并出现量价承接。

风险与失效条件：Amazon/Intel盘后负反馈压制AI资本开支交易；继续弱于板块或跌破当日低点即失效。

生益科技
SH.600183
条件关注

事实与状态：第三季归母净利润34.40亿元、增238.40%，前三季经营现金流60.66亿元；10月29日收94.12元、跌8.17%。

确认条件：开盘守住94元附近，PCB/覆铜板相对电子板块转强且半小时内跌幅收敛。

风险与失效条件：原材料上涨、扩产消化与高预期兑现；继续放量下跌或弱于PCB同业即失效。

东方证券
SH.600958
条件关注

事实与状态：购买上海证券100%股权获上交所并购重组审核通过；10月29日收8.25元、跌1.43%，审批链尚未结束。

确认条件：开盘守住8.25元附近且券商板块同步走强；公告本身不构成确认。

风险与失效条件：证监会注册、约22.89亿股发行摊薄、整合执行；跌破前收且板块走弱即失效。

百威亚太
HK.01876
回避

事实与状态：九个月收入、销量、正常化EBITDA分别降3.7%、4.9%、13.2%，第三季销量降10.1%；10月29日收5.66港元、跌2.58%。

确认条件：至少等待中国区销量和利润率改善，并持续强于恒指消费板块。

风险与失效条件：若后续销量改善且价格重新站稳5.80港元以上再评估；当前低价不是买点。

板块轮动看板

受益方向通信网络政策、海南贸易便利化；只选择有订单或利润证据的细分。
观察方向光模块、PCB与券商并购；财报强但公告前价格弱，必须开盘验证。
压力方向港股互联网、高估值科技、啤酒消费；美股互联网内容-9.77%与本地弱广度共振。
验证信号HSTECH相对恒指、创业板相对上证、前三十分钟成交与前收承接。

逻辑链

美股通信服务、软件和费半下跌，互联网内容行业榜落至-9.77%。
风险映射到港股互联网、恒生科技及A股高估值AI链，下调无价格确认的主题权重。
中际旭创、生益科技等本地业绩提供对冲，但公告前跌幅较大，只保留条件关注。
若开盘30分钟相对指数转强并守住前收附近，业绩线才确认；否则继续防守。

风险雷达

Amazon与Intel盘后负反馈可能令AI资本开支链继续去估值。
A股953涨、4363跌且中位数-1.73%，弱广度会放大高估值波动。
Brent 114.88美元且中东风险未解除，消费、运输和利率预期均受压。
东方证券交易仍需注册审批，发行摊薄与整合成本不能忽略。
15个排行代表股未取得可核验盘后成交，正向榜单延续性待确认。

Major News Summary
Global
Diplomacy hopes lowered oil, but supply risks remain
Brent settled at $114.88, down 0.38%, and WTI at $102, down 0.76%. Diplomacy hopes coexist with Houthi attacks and Hormuz risks. Source: Reuters.
Policy
Four agencies issued Hainan FTP trade-facilitation measures
The Oct 29 notice covers 16 measures including auto testing imports, LNG delivery, insurance, offshore trade and remanufacturing; benefits still need implementation and orders. Source: MOFCOM.
Industry
MIIT called for coordinated next-generation network buildout
The meeting covered terrestrial, space, international and integrated networks plus land, power, spectrum and financing support. This is a medium-term signal, not an immediate order. Source: MIIT.
Market
A/H technology lagged as AKShare breadth stayed weak
The Oct 29 13:49 CST snapshot showed 953 A-share advancers, 4,363 decliners and 97 unchanged, with a -1.73% median move; ChiNext fell 2.87%, STAR 50 3.04%, and HSTECH 2.03%. Source: AKShare.
US
Communication services and software sank; internet content ranked last
Nasdaq fell 1.37% and SOX 1.4%; Alphabet lost 12.6%, FTNT and NOW more than 20%, and MRVL 13.2%. Internet Content ranked -9.77%, versus Auto Dealerships +7.57% and Security +5.95%. Sources: Reuters, ranking snapshot.
After hours
Amazon and Intel reinforced concern over AI returns
AWS revenue rose 39% to $46 billion, but Amazon's trailing cash flow was negative $42.4 billion and capex topped estimates, sending shares down as much as 7%; Intel drew a sharper reaction. Source: Reuters.
Results
Zhongji Innolight grew sharply, but pre-report weakness is counterevidence
Nine-month revenue was RMB27.769bn and attributable profit RMB8.587bn, up 173.74%. The stock closed at RMB582.05, down 8.53%; the after-close report lacks post-report confirmation. Source: CNINFO.
Results
Eoptolink growth remained strong, but sequential and cash-flow pressure matter
Nine-month revenue was RMB10.940bn and profit RMB3.843bn. Q3 profit fell about 19% sequentially and operating cash flow declined year over year; the stock closed at RMB228.40, down 11.06%. Source: CNINFO.
Results
Shengyi Technology improved both earnings and cash flow
Q3 revenue rose 78.76% and profit reached RMB3.440bn, up 238.40%; nine-month operating cash flow was RMB6.066bn, up 90.99%. The stock closed at RMB94.12, down 8.17%. Source: filing.
M&A
Orient Securities' acquisition passed exchange review
The share-and-cash purchase of 100% of Shanghai Securities still needs CSRC and other approvals or registration. The stock closed at RMB8.25, down 1.43%; synergies must be weighed against dilution and integration. Source: CNINFO.
Hong Kong
Geely grew volume and profit, but price feedback stayed weak
Nine-month revenue was RMB272.564bn and profit RMB13.928bn, with core profit up 41%; the stock was around HKD13.67, down about 4% intraday, so growth alone is not bullish confirmation. Source: HKEX.
Hong Kong
BUD APAC's volume and margins weakened; status is Avoid
Nine-month revenue fell 3.7% to $4.62bn, volume fell 4.9% and normalized EBITDA fell 13.2%; Q3 volume fell 10.1%. The stock closed at HKD5.66, down 2.58%. Source: HKEX.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight indices
Overnight indices
A fresh 08:33 CST check returned delayed proxies of -1.41% for QQQ, -0.35% for SPY and -0.36% for DIA, with a 07:59 CST quote time. The source did not identify valid after-hours trades, so these are proxies, not index futures.
Sector comparison
Sector comparison
Internet Content & Information was -9.77%; Amazon fell as much as 7% after hours and Intel fell sharply, a confirmation of pressure on Hong Kong internet and high-valuation technology. Verifiable after-hours trades were unavailable for CRMT, ADT, LUXE, GTN.A, CROX, MINE, DASH, EXK, TEX, MAX, LLY, NCLH, ESCA, HII and ARAY. Weak proxies create a divergence from positive rankings, but do not yet confirm a reversal.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping
Test relative strength in HSTECH, Hong Kong internet and A-share optics/PCB. Conditional Watch requires Zhongji and Shengyi to hold near prior closes while sector losses narrow; continued HSTECH underperformance or no first-30-minute support invalidates.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: prior A-share and HSTECH breadth was weak; US communication services, software and semiconductors fell, and Amazon/Intel added after-hours concern over AI returns.

View: a soft, divergent open is more likely. Defensive areas and local earnings support come first; optics, PCB and broker consolidation remain Conditional Watch and need relative-strength confirmation.

Structural support comes from network policy, Hainan trade facilitation and selected results.Uncertainty remains because most leaders lack reliable after-hours trades, oil is high and technology already showed negative price feedback.

Stocks to Watch

Zhongji Innolight
SZ.300308
Conditional Watch

Facts and status：Nine-month revenue was RMB27.769bn and profit RMB8.587bn, up 173.74%. It closed at RMB582.05, down 8.53%, without post-report confirmation.

Confirmation：Avoid a material gap below RMB582.05, then outperform ChiNext and communications equipment during the first 30 minutes.

Risk and invalidation：Amazon/Intel weakness pressures the AI capex trade; continued sector underperformance or a break of the session low invalidates.

Shengyi Technology
SH.600183
Conditional Watch

Facts and status：Q3 profit was RMB3.440bn, up 238.40%, and nine-month operating cash flow RMB6.066bn. It closed at RMB94.12, down 8.17%.

Confirmation：Hold near RMB94 and show first-30-minute relative strength in PCB/copper-clad laminate versus electronics.

Risk and invalidation：Raw-material inflation, capacity absorption and high expectations; continued high-volume selling or peer underperformance invalidates.

Orient Securities
SH.600958
Conditional Watch

Facts and status：The purchase of 100% of Shanghai Securities passed SSE M&A review. It closed at RMB8.25, down 1.43%, with approvals incomplete.

Confirmation：Hold near RMB8.25 with simultaneous broker-sector strength; the announcement alone is not confirmation.

Risk and invalidation：CSRC registration, dilution from about 2.289bn shares and integration; a break below prior close with a weak sector invalidates.

BUD APAC
HK.01876
Avoid

Facts and status：Nine-month revenue, volume and normalized EBITDA fell 3.7%, 4.9% and 13.2%; Q3 volume fell 10.1%. It closed at HKD5.66, down 2.58%.

Confirmation：Wait for better China volume and margins plus sustained outperformance versus Hang Seng consumer peers.

Risk and invalidation：Reassess only if volume improves and price retakes HKD5.80; the current low price is not a buy signal.

Sector Rotation Board

Potential beneficiariesNetwork policy and Hainan trade facilitation, limited to segments with order or profit evidence.
WatchOptics, PCB and broker consolidation; strong filings but weak pre-report prices need opening confirmation.
PressureHong Kong internet, high-valuation technology and beer; US Internet Content -9.77% aligns with weak local breadth.
ValidationHSTECH versus HSI, ChiNext versus SSE, and first-30-minute support around prior closes.

Logic Chain

US communication services, software and semiconductors fell, while Internet Content ranked -9.77%.
That maps to Hong Kong internet, HSTECH and high-valuation A-share AI, lowering unconfirmed themes.
Local results at Zhongji and Shengyi provide a counterweight, but large pre-report losses keep them at Conditional Watch.
Only first-30-minute relative strength and support near prior closes confirm the earnings trade; otherwise stay defensive.

Risk Radar

Amazon and Intel weakness may continue to compress AI capex valuations.
Breadth of 953 advancers versus 4,363 decliners and a -1.73% median move amplifies volatility.
Brent at $114.88 and unresolved Middle East risk pressure consumption, transport and rates.
Orient Securities still needs approvals; dilution and integration costs matter.
Reliable after-hours trades were unavailable for all 15 ranking representatives.
